_comment: TTS-only respellings for Grades R-3 phonics lines (voice_batch/r3_lines.py). Key: the app's R3Line key (by_key) or an exact line text (by_text); value: what the voice is asked to say instead, so it says the letter SOUND, never the letter NAME. The display text in the pack never changes. Lines rendered from a respelling are ASR-checked against this text and flagged needs_listen in the manifest. Draft: sounds are spelled ah (a as in ant), aw (o as in on), ih (i as in insect), mmm, sss, and a short 'uh' after the stops and v/j/n/w (buh, duh, guh, juh, kuh, nuh, vuh, wuh).
